comparison.objective: Rotate moving cartons so labels face a scanner; candidate screens finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception and yaw correction on a moving line versus pouring, agitation, and orientation-dependent particle passage.
comparison.success_condition: Each carton readable, upright, released at the gate versus ≥98% media recovery with all washers retained.
comparison.reason: Moving-line object reorientation does not test granular screening.
